name: Jedi From The Start
package: Jedi from the Start v4.0.0 (shipped README; HoloPatcher; tested archive Jedi from the Start-1-4-0-0)
notes: Replaces eighteen module files and adds a class selector to the Endar Spire opening; the chosen class is granted with AddMultiClass, which the co-op class-grant relay publishes.
Every module it replaces is covered by the content digest (name, size and SHA-256 of each modules file), so two different versions of the mod are caught even at equal file size.
Live-run 2026-09-29: a connected joiner got its own Jedi-choice prompt after the host picked a class.

Detection markers were checked against the Jedi from the Start-1-4-0-0 archive on 2026-09-30. Its shipped README identifies v4.0.0; the earlier filename v4.0.0.7z ends in the .7z archive extension. Detection does not certify other releases.
No campaign-module or companion rule: it adds no companions. This declaration detects the mod; it does not mirror script-created friendly creatures or guarantee live world adoption.
